titles.title: When Did You Grow Up So Much?

description: “...Then, noona, you can check it with your body.” Eight years ago, Sunho, whom she met in the boy group survival program , was just 18 years old, a trainee in his second year. “When did you grow up so much that you can drink with noona?” “...Huh?!” As Eunsu wrapped her arms around Sunho’s neck and pulled him closer, Sunho’s arms gave way. “Ah, wait.” Sunho, who had ended up on top of Eunsu, was startled and lifted his lower body. Seeing that, Eunsu chuckled. “You’ve grown up well, so well.” Eunsu’s hand, patting him and saying he’d grown up well, was so small, and her voice was soft. Sunho, looking at such an Eunsu, mumbled. \*\*Original Webtoon:\*\* \[Ridibooks\](https://ridibooks.com/books/5285003288)
